heroHeadline: June 6 Second Surge: 22 PLA Sorties (2 Cross Median into C+SW ADIZ), 8 PLAN — Third-Highest Non-Exercise Count Ever; June 7 Pullback: 4 Sorties, 9 PLAN + 7 Official Ships (Official Ships Triple); Full June Sequence: 7→18→32 RECORD→7→22→4; $14B Arms 'Under Review' (Rubio Jun 3); US FMS Pause (Iran) Active
heroSubtitle: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense on June 6, 2026 detected 22 PLA aircraft sorties — a 214% re-escalation from June 5's 7-sortie post-record pullback — with 2 of 22 crossing the Taiwan Strait median line into central and southwestern ADIZ sectors. Eight PLAN vessels and 2 official ships maintained maritime presence. The 22-sortie count is the third-highest non-exercise total ever recorded, behind only June 4's all-time record of 32 sorties (25 crossing all four ADIZ sectors simultaneously) and May 2's prior record of 29. June 7 brought the predictable post-surge pullback: 4 sorties (down 82%) — but official ship count more than tripled from 2 to 7, the highest official ship count since late May, as PLAN vessels held at 9. The June 7 official ship surge (coast guard + naval vessels) reflects PLA's gray-zone hybrid strategy of compensating reduced air pressure with elevated maritime legal presence. Full June 2026 sequence: 7 (Jun 2) → 18 (Jun 3) → 32 RECORD (Jun 4) → 7 (Jun 5) → 22 (Jun 6) → 4 (Jun 7). Extended sequence: 4→29→1→2→1→0→22→12→8→12→7→9→2→3→15→6→7→13→24→7→6→16→4→9→26→10→9→10→16→1→8→7→18→32→7→22→4. June 4 Tiananmen 37th: President Lai called on China to 'face up to the incident'; Taiwan held candlelight vigil. Secretary Rubio testified June 3: $14B arms package 'under review,' not paused; US does not consult Beijing on arms decisions. US FMS pause for Operation Epic Fury (Iran) active. HIMARS NT$800M down payment MET May 31; NT$8.81B procurement budget passed May 29. Taiwan GDP forecast 9.64% (16-year high); Nvidia $150B/year Taiwan suppliers (Computex 2026).
